# MinecraftModelMigrator-Pro — GeckoLib Resource Mapping

**Mod ID**: `srp`
**Package**: `com.srp`
**Generated by**: package_mod_dev.py

## Resource Path Convention

| Resource Type | Path Pattern |
|---|---|
| Geometry | `assets/srp/geo/<category>_<model>.geo.json` |
| Animation | `assets/srp/animations/<category>_<model>.animation.json` |
| Texture | `assets/srp/textures/entity/<category>_<model>.png` |
